name: hubstaff
description: Connect to Hubstaff through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Official read-only MCP for owners and managers of active Hubstaff organizations, connected by adding it to an MCP client and signing in; the page's invitation to contact support about 'early access' sets no documented gate. Hubstaff's pricing page offers a self-serve 14-day trial without a card, then paid Starter, Grow and Team plans that each have a 2-seat minimum, so the route needs a paid plan and consumer_accounts is business-only; an older support article describing a free plan for individual freelancers conflicts with the pricing page. The exact endpoint path is not in Hubstaff docs, the host comes from its protected resource metadata. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR no, CIMD yes (account.hubstaff.com), S256.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
